title: The Seed That Slept Underground
intro: This quiz covers Asha's discovery of how a seed germinates and grows into a young plant.

questions.prompt: What did Asha do after placing the seed in the soil?
choices: She gave it water and gently patted the soil
She immediately pulled it back out
She placed it in a freezer
questions.explanation: Asha gave the seed water and gently patted the soil.

questions.prompt: What happened first when the seed received water?
choices: Its coat softened, and the tiny plant inside began to stir
questions.explanation: The seed's coat softened, and the tiny plant inside began to stir.

questions.prompt: What three things did the seed need to begin germinating?
questions.explanation: The seed needed water, air, and warmth to begin germinating.

questions.prompt: Which part of the plant grew first?

choices: The moment a seed begins to grow into a new plant
The time when a plant loses its leaves
The movement of pollen between flowers
questions.explanation: Germination is the moment a seed begins to grow into a new plant.
